contract.purpose: Recreate the historical Box occlusion comparison with the qualified closed Mesh CollisionProxy and require matching numeric and visual evidence before PointEmitter coexistence begins.

geometry_contract.primary_distance: signed shortest distance to the exact authored 8-vertex, 6-face closed Mesh
geometry_contract.boundary_band: actual-Mesh inside with signed depth in [0,1] native velocity voxel; reported and excluded from hard maximum
geometry_contract.deep_interior: actual-Mesh signed depth greater than 1 native velocity voxel
geometry_contract.center_axis: deep interior and horizontal distance to Box Z center line at most 0.5 native velocity voxel

contract.scope_if_pass: Only the fixed axis-aligned Box, Flow 110.0.0, current fixed grid, closed Mesh CollisionProxy, and the isolated Sphere-source comparison; no production integration or PointEmitter qualification.
